about: Golden vectors for the InfinAssistant BLE protocol: one source for the firmware host tests (tools/fuzz), the app tests (android/core-data) and the Home Assistant tests (ha_integration/tests/test_protocol_compat.py). A hex field is a CBOR payload as bytes on the wire; a value is a plain number. Change a vector here and every side that pins it fails until it agrees. Not part of the firmware build (outside src/).

vectors.name: hello_features_word
vectors.description: The HELLO feature word of firmware 2.4.103: 0x1FBFF, bits 0-9, 11-16 (bit 10 stays retired). A 32-bit CBOR unsigned int (5 bytes); the word was 0xFBFF (3 bytes) until 2.4.102.

vectors.name: hello_features_word_2_4_102
vectors.description: The HELLO feature word of firmware 2.4.65 to 2.4.102 for comparison: 0xFBFF, no bit 16. An app that reads it must ask for a firmware update and send no CONFIG_PUSH.

vectors.name: config_key_v2_bit
vectors.description: Feature bit 16, CONFIG_KEY_V2: the CONFIG_PUSH decoder reads the key infinassistant. Firmware before 2.4.103 cannot set it.

vectors.name: hello_watch_2_4_103
vectors.description: A hand-made sample of the watch HELLO of 2.4.103, laid out as BridgeController::HandleHello encodes it (the same 15 keys in the same order, definite-length map); it is not captured from the firmware and not produced by HandleHello. 224 bytes with these sample values (222 bytes before bit 16). The frame limit is 244.

vectors.name: config_push_v2
vectors.description: CONFIG_PUSH as the app writes it: configVersion 1, the sensor reports on at 120 s under the key infinassistant, voice assist on. An indefinite-length map (BF ... FF); defaults are left out.

vectors.name: status_fingerprint
vectors.description: DASHBOARD_STATE status fingerprint (FNV-1a 32-bit, offset 0x811C9DC5, prime 16777619): per group the glyph count as one byte, then each glyph symbol as one byte. The groups are listed in order.

vectors.name: notify_remove_nid7
vectors.description: NOTIFY_REMOVE for nid 7, as the app writes it (indefinite-length map).

vectors.name: notify_dismiss_nid7
vectors.description: NOTIFY_DISMISS for nid 7, as the watch writes it (definite-length map).

vectors.name: notify_phone_nid7
vectors.description: A phone NOTIFY (title Al, body Hi, tag 7, ts 1, nid 7) as the app writes it.

vectors.name: notify_phone_nid12_alice
vectors.description: A phone NOTIFY (title Alice, body "Dinner at 7?", severity info, tag 12, ts 1700000000000, nid 12) as the app writes it.

vectors.name: pong_rid5_enc_false
vectors.description: PONG for request 5 on an unencrypted link (firmware 2.4.101+).

vectors.name: pong_rid5_enc_true
vectors.description: PONG for request 5 on an encrypted link.

vectors.name: crc32_single_zero_byte
vectors.description: CRC-32 (ISO 3309, as binascii.crc32) of the single byte 00, the CONFIG_PUSH_ACK checksum reference.
